title: Fixed Through Feed and Extension Table Thickness Planer
description: One newly authored complete static bench thickness-planer appearance. A low grounded chamfered base carries a full central feed bed, two tall side columns and a broad upper motor head with a separate top cover. A genuine low rectangular passage remains open from front to back between the bed and recessed feed-roll silhouettes. Two entire flat extension tables extend in opposite directions on whole transverse hinge axles and finite support braces. A complete offset height-crank silhouette on the right and a blank front rocker enclosure finish the exterior. Not a bench drill with a wider table or an exposed hand wringer recoloured; no old geometry imported. Three opaque PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Empty fixed static art only: no cutting edges, timber payload, feed or height adjustment, motor, machining performance, dust collection, manufacture, load or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
